description_blocks.text: Overview

Meet the Mini SUV CyberBrick RC – where iconic 4x4 design meets CyberBrick ecosystem. It features a classic, robust body with a distinctive grille and spare tire. Its proportional steering and efficient drivetrain deliver precise control on any terrain when paired with the CyberBrick system. Best of all, it requires no AMS, no supports, and no glue—making it effortless to print, customize with your color, and bring to life using the beginner-friendly CyberBrick Starter Kit. Your complete creative off-road experience starts now.
Find all files and details on its MakerWorld Page.
*For a smooth build, we recommend reviewing the assembly guide first.
Design & Performance
Realistic appearance: Featuring a robust body, distinctive grille, and spare tire mount, this Mini SUV captures the essence of a classic off-roader in perfectly proportioned miniature form.
Precision Control: By combining proportional steering with an efficient drivetrain, the Mini SUV provides seamless response and precise control on any surface.
Expand Your Play
Outdoor Exploration: Take your Mini SUV outdoors to conquer real-world terrain like gravel paths and grassy slopes, discovering its capabilities in various environments

Build Your Own Off-Road Game: Transform any space into an adventure course. Build challenging obstacles with natural elements, then put your precision control into the game. Perfect your technique and challenge friends to head-to-head races.
Beginner-Friendly
Officially Verified Design: Both the model and instruction manual are officially tested to ensure successful printing and smooth assembly.
All-in-One Experience: Only the CyberBrick Starter Kit is required—no complicated part sourcing.
Simplified Assembly: Requires no supports or glue, and uses snap-fit designs to significantly reduce screw usage, saving your printing and assembly time.
Creative Freedom

Efficient & Smart Printing: Optimized for single-color printing—no AMS required, no support needed. This streamlined approach not only saves printing time but also reduces material waste by eliminating filament changes.
Your Color, Your Style: Choose your favorite filament color to print the SUV body, creating a truly one-of-a-kind vehicle that reflects your personal creative vision.
Remote Control Instruction
The Mini SUV is designed to work with the CyberBrick Official Remote. The creator has uploaded pre-configured settings for immediate play,
while the CyberBrick App allows full customization of controller functions to match your personal preferences.
* Please visit the CyberBrick Official Standard Remote on Makerworld for more details.

Core Safety Rules
This product is intended for users aged 16 and above. Users under the age of 16 must be under direct adult supervision throughout use.
Please use only official tools for any firmware operations. Flashing with third-party tools is not supported and may cause irreversible damage, which is not covered by warranty.
DO NOT touch the moving tracks or wheels while the device is operating to prevent pinching injuries.
Warning of Lithium Battery
This product utilizes a replaceable rechargeable lithium battery.
Adult supervision is required when children are handling batteries or the charger. Do not operate the product while it is charging.
Ensure the battery is installed correctly. Improper installation may result in short circuits, overheating, or potential explosion.
Regularly inspect the charger’s cord, plug, housing, and other components for damage. If any damage is found, discontinue use immediately until the device is fully repaired.
Choking Hazard: Contains small parts; not suitable for children under 3 years of age.
Improper disposal of this product may harm the environment - please recycle responsibly.
Charging Precautions
Use only the officially supplied charger. The charger is not a toy.

The USB charger for this product only supports standard 5V 1-2A input. Please always use the original charger that meets the voltage/current requirements, or charge directly via a computer USB port. DO NOT use chargers with output higher than 5V or 2A (such as mobile fast chargers, 9V/12V adapters, etc.), as this may cause device damage, overheating, or even serious fire hazards.
DO NOT cover the device while charging, and keep it away from high temperature, humidity, or flammable environments. Never charge the device unattended.
DO NOT charge the battery pack if it is overheating. Allow it to cool down completely before recharging.
If the battery pack or charger becomes wet, ensure they are thoroughly dry before attempting to charge.
Lithium Battery Safety Precautions
DO NOT attempt to use or charge the battery pack if it shows any signs of leakage or corrosion.
DO NOT disassemble, crush, or mechanically abuse the battery pack.
DO NOT dispose of the battery pack in fire.
Exercise extreme caution when handling an overheated battery pack.

Overview

Meet the Mini SUV CyberBrick RC – where iconic 4x4 design meets CyberBrick ecosystem. It features a classic, robust body with a distinctive grille and spare tire. Its proportional steering and efficient drivetrain deliver precise control on any terrain when paired with the CyberBrick system. Find all files and details on its MakerWorld Page.

*For a smooth build, we recommend reviewing the assembly guide first.

Design & Performance

  • Realistic appearance: Featuring a robust body, distinctive grille, and spare tire mount, this Mini SUV captures the essence of a classic off-roader in perfectly proportioned miniature form.
  • Precision Control: By combining proportional steering with an efficient drivetrain, the Mini SUV provides seamless response and precise control on any surface.
*The 1:21 Gear Kit (LA012) offers higher speed than the 1:48 gear included in kits (ZK004).

Expand Your Play

  • Outdoor Exploration: Take your Mini SUV outdoors to conquer real-world terrain like gravel paths and grassy slopes, discovering its capabilities in various environments
  • Build Your Own Off-Road Game: Transform any space into an adventure course. Build challenging obstacles with natural elements, then put your precision control into the game. Perfect your technique and challenge friends to head-to-head races.

Beginner-Friendly

  • Officially Verified Design: Both the model and instruction manual are officially tested to ensure successful printing and smooth assembly.
  • All-in-One Experience: Only the CyberBrick Starter Kit is required—no complicated part sourcing.
  • Simplified Assembly: Requires no supports or glue, and uses snap-fit designs to significantly reduce screw usage, saving your printing and assembly time.

Creative Freedom

  • Efficient & Smart Printing: Optimized for single-color printing—no AMS required, no support needed. This streamlined approach not only saves printing time but also reduces material waste by eliminating filament changes.
  • Your Color, Your Style: Choose your favorite filament color to print the SUV body, creating a truly one-of-a-kind vehicle that reflects your personal creative vision.

Remote Control Instruction

The Mini SUV is designed to work with the CyberBrick Official Remote. The creator has uploaded pre-configured settings for immediate play,

while the CyberBrick App allows full customization of controller functions to match your personal preferences.

* Please visit the CyberBrick Official Standard Remote on Makerworld for more details.

Important Notices

Core Safety Rules

  • This product is intended for users aged 16 and above. Users under the age of 16 must be under direct adult supervision throughout use.
  • Please use only official tools for any firmware operations. Flashing with third-party tools is not supported and may cause irreversible damage, which is not covered by warranty.
  • DO NOT touch the moving tracks or wheels while the device is operating to prevent pinching injuries.

Warning of Lithium Battery

  • This product utilizes a replaceable rechargeable lithium battery.
  • Adult supervision is required when children are handling batteries or the charger. Do not operate the product while it is charging.
  • Ensure the battery is installed correctly. Improper installation may result in short circuits, overheating, or potential explosion.
  • Regularly inspect the charger’s cord, plug, housing, and other components for damage. If any damage is found, discontinue use immediately until the device is fully repaired.
  • Choking Hazard: Contains small parts; not suitable for children under 3 years of age.
  • Improper disposal of this product may harm the environment - please recycle responsibly.

Charging Precautions

  • Use only the officially supplied charger. The charger is not a toy.
  • The USB charger for this product only supports standard 5V 1-2A input. Please always use the original charger that meets the voltage/current requirements, or charge directly via a computer USB port. DO NOT use chargers with output higher than 5V or 2A (such as mobile fast chargers, 9V/12V adapters, etc.), as this may cause device damage, overheating, or even serious fire hazards.
  • DO NOT cover the device while charging, and keep it away from high temperature, humidity, or flammable environments. Never charge the device unattended.
  • DO NOT charge the battery pack if it is overheating. Allow it to cool down completely before recharging.
  • If the battery pack or charger becomes wet, ensure they are thoroughly dry before attempting to charge.

Lithium Battery Safety Precautions

  • DO NOT attempt to use or charge the battery pack if it shows any signs of leakage or corrosion.
  • DO NOT disassemble, crush, or mechanically abuse the battery pack.
  • DO NOT dispose of the battery pack in fire.
  • Exercise extreme caution when handling an overheated battery pack.
